title: Vanilla Twist
description: Vanilla with a twist, tons of QoL, Deco, Tools, Structures, Mobs to fight and gadgets to collect. Create + Immersive Engineering & Tom's Storage to expand how you can process and store your items. Don't forget, you'll need to build a runway :)
body: Vanilla with a twist, LOTS of quality of life changes, new furniture, machines to keep you occupied without adding over complex systems, new animals and variants of vanilla mobs, Tinkers Construct for all your tooling needs and Deeper and Darker to explore to new depths.
